const status=root.querySelector('[role=status]'),controls=[...root.querySelectorAll('input')],names=['Tone','Filter','Decay','Volume'],keys=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-note]')];let audio;const timers=new Set();function play(midi,button){if(!audio)try{audio=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)()}catch(e){}if(audio){audio.resume();const osc=audio.createOscillator(),gain=audio.createGain(),filter=audio.createBiquadFilter(),now=audio.currentTime,duration=.18+(+controls[2].value/100)*1.5;osc.type=+controls[0].value<50?'sine':'triangle';osc.frequency.value=440*Math.pow(2,(midi-69)/12);filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=400+(+controls[1].value/100)*7000;gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0,now);gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(+controls[3].value/100*.2,now+.012);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+duration);osc.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(audio.destination);osc.start(now);osc.stop(now+duration+.02);osc.onended=()=>{osc.disconnect();filter.disconnect();gain.disconnect()}}button.dataset.on='true';root.dataset.playing='true';root.querySelector('small').textContent=String(midi);status.textContent=button.getAttribute('aria-label').replace('Play ','')+' played';const timer=setTimeout(()=>{button.dataset.on='false';root.dataset.playing='false';timers.delete(timer)},250);timers.add(timer)}const natural=[60,62,64,65,67,69,71,72,74,76],sharp=[61,63,66,68,70,73,75];keys.forEach((b,i)=>b.onclick=()=>play(natural[i],b));root.querySelectorAll('[data-black]').forEach((b,i)=>b.onclick=()=>play(sharp[i],b));root.tabIndex=0;root.setAttribute('aria-label','Pocket synthesizer. Keys A through L play notes.');root.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.target.matches('input,button'))return;const i=['a','s','d','f','g','h','j','k','l',';'].indexOf(e.key.toLowerCase());if(i<0||e.repeat)return;e.preventDefault();play(natural[i],keys[i])};controls.forEach((input,i)=>{function update(){input.nextElementSibling.style.setProperty('--angle',(-135+Number(input.value)*2.7)+'deg');input.setAttribute('aria-valuetext',input.value+' percent');if(i===0)root.querySelector('.d-hardware-op1-panel-screen>span').textContent=+input.value<50?'Sine':'Triangle'}input.oninput=()=>{update();status.textContent=names[i]+' '+input.value+' percent'};update()});const cleanup=setInterval(()=>{if(root.isConnected)return;clearInterval(cleanup);timers.forEach(clearTimeout);if(audio)audio.close()},1500);
return function(){clearInterval(cleanup);timers.forEach(clearTimeout);if(audio&&audio.state!=="closed")audio.close()};

const summary=root.querySelector('.d-hardware-dynamic-notch-summary'),player=root.querySelector('.d-hardware-dynamic-notch-player'),status=root.querySelector('[role=status]'),seek=root.querySelector('input'),play=root.querySelector('[data-play]');let expanded=false,playing=false,timer;function expand(next){expanded=next;root.dataset.expanded=String(next);summary.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(next));player.hidden=!next;status.textContent=next?'Player expanded':'Player collapsed';if(!next)summary.focus();else root.querySelector('[data-play]').focus()}function setTime(value){seek.value=value;root.querySelector('[data-time]').textContent=Math.floor(value/60)+':'+String(value%60).padStart(2,'0');seek.setAttribute('aria-valuetext',root.querySelector('[data-time]').textContent+' of 3:30')}function setPlaying(value){playing=value;play.textContent=value?'Ⅱ':'▶';play.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(value));play.setAttribute('aria-label',value?'Pause track':'Play track');status.textContent=value?'Playback running':'Playback paused'}summary.onclick=()=>expand(true);root.querySelector('[data-collapse]').onclick=()=>expand(false);play.onclick=()=>setPlaying(!playing);seek.oninput=()=>setTime(+seek.value);root.querySelector('[data-prev]').onclick=()=>{setTime(0);status.textContent='Track restarted'};root.querySelector('[data-next]').onclick=()=>{root.querySelector('.d-hardware-dynamic-notch-player p').firstChild.textContent='Still Life';setTime(0);status.textContent='Next track: Still Life'};root.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&expanded){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();expand(false)}};timer=setInterval(()=>{if(!root.isConnected){clearInterval(timer);return}if(playing){setTime(Math.min(210,+seek.value+1));if(+seek.value===210)setPlaying(false)}},1000);setTime(43);
return function(){clearInterval(timer)};
